title: Shōzen TV Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals April 2027 Debut
content: The staff for Shōzen , the television anime adaptation of Jiang Jia Meizi 's Chinese manhua Shang Shan , revealed on Wednesday the anime's first promotional video and April 2027 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Chinese Fantasy Manhua Shozen Reveals First Anime Trailer, April 2027 Release Date
content: The upcoming anime adaptation of Shozen has released its first full trailer, confirming an April 2027 release date. The series is based on Jiang Jia Meizi’s fantasy manhua, which is serialized on Bilibili Manga.
author: Anime Corner

title: Koma-Dori Mofmof Parade Stop-Motion Anime Unveils Cast, Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Wednesday the main cast and staff members, and January 2027 debut of Koma-Dori Mofmof Parade (Stop-Motion Mofmof Parade or KomaMof for short), the stop-motion anime of the IDOLiSH7 franchise 's Mofmof mini characters' Mofmof Parade (or MofPara for short) project.
author: ANN

title: Twin Engine, Bandai Partner for Manga, Animation, Merchandise Plans
content: Anime planning and production company Twin Engine (production for Vinland Saga , Dororo , Hell's Paradise: Jigokuraku ) announced on Wednesday that it has entered into a strategic partnership with toy and merchandising company Bandai Co., Ltd. with the two companies planning to produce at least one new joint project.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action My Sister's Boyfriend Film's Teaser Announces More Cast
content: The official website for My Sister's Boyfriend, the live-action film of Amu Meguro 's Midori Loves My Sister ( Onē-chan no Midori-kun or literally My Sister's Midori-kun) manga, presented a new teaser trailer and poster visual for the film on Wednesday. The teaser announces more cast members for the film.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Z: Exploring The Controversial Time Before The Anime’s Toonami Arrival
content: Dragon Ball is, arguably, one of the biggest anime franchises to make the leap from Japan to North America, as there’s just something about the life of Son Goku that Western audiences have grown to love.
author: ComicBook

title: My Happy Marriage Author Akumi Agitogi, Fiancée of the Wizard Manga Artist Masaki Kazuka Launch New Manga
content: Kadokawa 's B's-LOG COMIC online manga magazine published on July 24 Chapter 0 of a new manga titled Miko to Yashayome by author Akumi Agitogi ( My Happy Marriage ) and artist Masaki Kazuka ( Fiancée of the Wizard ). The manga starts serialization in the magazine on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Classic Rom-Com Anime to Return With New Release After Crunchyroll Removal
content: A classic romantic comedy anime is coming back with a new physical release after its removal from streaming platforms like Crunchyroll, and that means it’s going to be much easier to watch from now on.
author: ComicBook

title: Hashihime of the Old Book Town Developer's О̄e Game Gets Manga Adaptation
content: The September issue of Kadokawa 's Young Ace Magazine announced on Tuesday that Hashihime of the Old Book Town visual novel developer ADELTA's О̄e (Great Corruption) game will get a manga adaptation by Medamayaki titled О̄e: Ariake-hen (Great Corruption: The Dawn Arc) in the October issue.
author: ANN

title: 7 Years Ago, A Cartoon Network/Sonic Crossover Erupted on The Screen
content: Sonic the Hedgehog isn’t a stranger to Cartoon Network , as one of the biggest animated representations of the Sega mascot had a series of his own on the cable network. Sonic Boom is one of the most beloved cartoons in the hedgehog’s history, first premiering on Cartoon Network in 2014.
author: ComicBook
